# Jacob D. Rochte | jrochte@etechgroup.com | rochteja@gmail.com

v0.1
Initial creation, view from console script. 
Exports instances and udts.

v0.2
Addition of project export and gateway export for linux servers.

v1.0
Initial release with updated graphics based on feedback.
Creation of Parts folder and embedded views.
Changed from dropdown box to radio buttons.

v1.1
Adds support for windows server project and gateway exports.

v1.2
Updated look and feel.
Added a popup for an about page with information about what it exports.
Added Export All button.

v1.3
Added Clear button to output.
Export All button now zips all four files into one zip archive and downloads.

v1.4
Conformed to the Inductive Automation Exchange standards.

v1.5
Added support for ignition gateways installed on Mac OS

v1.6
Created a zip archive of the individual tag exports (Instances and UDTs). This has a compression ration of >95%

v1.7
Dynamically find the install location of Ignition to account for different folder structures.
Including: Linux, Windows, Mac, Docker

v1.8
Edited based on IA feedback to be better aligned with the Exchange Resource Style Guide

v2.0
Added export for wrapper logs, exports up to wrapper.log.9
